site.sitedescription: Moraine dammed lake that lies on the eastern flang of the eastern cordillera of the northern Peruvian Andes. The lake is partially encircled by timberline forest and is situated in an ecotone, with tropical alpine vegetation (known locally as páramo or puna). Within these grasslands are tussock-forming Calamagrostis, Cortaderia, and Festuca, with poorly drained areas dominated by sedges (Carex, Isolepis, Oreobolus, Scirpus, Uncinia). The lake has abundant submerged Isoëtes lechleri.
